svg.aria-label: Tech stack: AI & agents: Anthropic API, OpenAI API, Tool calling, Agent loops, Streaming (SSE); Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, Flask, C# / .NET, REST APIs; Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Angular, Tailwind CSS; Data & cloud: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma, Google Cloud, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub; Quality & delivery: Playwright, Selenium, Vitest, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes
